sources.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTA 6 Trophy List, all 55 trophies (PSNProfiles, TrueAchievements)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself at the end. There is no separate task, so just work through the three roadmap stages and the platinum will follow.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, through to the end. Story missions cannot be missed, so the trophy appears when the mission wraps up.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep going through the opening missions until the first chapter comes to a close. The trophy shows up as Chapter 1 ends.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play the main story until Chapter 2 is finished. The trophy appears the moment the chapter closes.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Reach the end of Chapter 3 and the trophy pops with the chapter's last mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The trophy arrives when the chapter ends.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the game's final mission to its end. It is one of the two Gold trophies, and it pops once the last mission is over.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. As a story mission it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Story mission, so it pops on its own.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. It pops when that story mission ends.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. Story mission, unmissable.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It pops at the end of that story mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Story mission, so it unlocks on its own.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. The bar is lenient at roughly 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges done, plus the robberies and activities. Most of the checklist overlaps with other trophies, so leave this push until the story is finished.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind out of the 397 in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Bridge flights are the fastest way to raise the count. Watch the total under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, car and drone races, and stunts. The counter is under Progress, Activities. Most of them happen on their own while chasing other trophies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold targets are forgiving here, and range practice also builds the Focus level that Gunslinger needs.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race in each of the 14 locations, 42 races in all. One win per location is enough, you do not have to win every race.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. They have to be 20 separate race locations, not the same race twenty times over.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Once the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui is done, Cal texts you a fishing spot. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the TV at home, the fourth runs on arcade machines around the map. Clear all the levels once; beating every challenge is not required.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's 5-mission line as Lucia: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. It opens with a call from Andy in Chapter 3 and stays open after the story.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's line: dive for his treasures at 7 shipwrecks. It begins in Chapter 1 in Key Lento. Kenton falls silent for a stretch after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapter 2 or 3, so nothing here can be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's 5-mission line at the Thrillbilly Mud Club: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands that count for this one. Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Keep an eye on the count in the trophy list.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List by delivering the 16 sports cars he wants. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, once you have the Key Cloner. Stolen cars go to his garage in west Vice City.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's line as Jason: wreck the Synthetic Labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then play the Spin On This mission. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. A spot done with both Jason and Lucia counts twice. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as Lucia at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends, it may be required and it goes away after the chapter. The final spot only opens once both characters can play together after Coffee Break.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Play Bret Vogel's hunting line as Jason. It opens with a text from Bret after Coffee Break. Hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. The unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 helps, and the 15 Target Decks count toward 100%.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida, so pick the three simplest to complete.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app. Any 100 will do: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. There are well over 100 in the world, so scan as you travel.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. 100% needs 70 of 80, so this one pops on the way to A Long Road. Start with the easiest ones.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Hit a 4-star wanted level with your partner at your side, then break out of the heat zone. It works best after Coffee Break, when you can call your partner over. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another while holding a wanted level the whole time. Do not let the wanted level fall between shops. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. Stand by a busy road and scan the traffic going past. 100% needs 200, so this one comes first.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming). Build your Focus level first at shooting ranges, golf, pool or fishing, eat or use Adrenaline to stretch the window, and use an assault rifle at a gang operation.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger plane parked at a departure terminal at VCIA, terminals E3 and E4 are the simplest. Climb into the cockpit, drive it back to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map. Get inside a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, rob a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun so no alarm goes off. Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm, then walk out.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and get away each time. They open up after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Trail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault stands open, and bring your partner along to carry a second bag. All 8 are needed for 100%.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and break out of the heat radius. It pops in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, or earlier by blocking a truck, sticking a bomb on its back door and getting away.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. Fly a plane over every fogged stretch until the map is fully revealed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs, 39 operations in total. They appear as yellow icons when you get close. All 39 are needed for 100%, so this one pops along the way.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, order an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Once you have the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. Only that blue Banshee counts, and the pop comes a little late.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation, take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east, and the safe in the north-east hallway, opened with sticky bombs. Escape the police to pop it.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together at a fitness club, call your partner first so both train at once, or work out at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. Switch on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications. Robberies, fights and escapes all count, and the total builds up on its own while you chase the other trophies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unconfirmed, thought to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No verified method exists yet, so check the guide again once more players have finished the game.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg: at night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked there, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, walk up to it, talk to the woman it drops off and help her back to her car.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unconfirmed, thought to come from kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle, a melee drive-by. No verified method exists yet, so check the guide again once more players have finished the game.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through a fence, Yasmani in Vice City pays the best rate. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. The total adds up across all robberies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages you can own, $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first, Little Boxes, for parking space, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and pick Respray and Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
